hero_h1: Source it. Pack it. Ship it. Deliver it.
hero_lead: Four connected capabilities that let one supplier handle everything — from a grower's farm gate to a mine-site mess on a Pacific island.
export_body: From straight loads to mixed and consolidated containers, we design shipments around what our customers actually need — not what's easiest for us to pack. We hold active shipping relationships on Pacific lanes and run our own in-country importer in PNG to handle customs, quarantine and delivery.
procurement_heading: Whatever you need, we can usually source it.
procurement_body: We've built a highly diversified supply base that lets us quickly and efficiently source virtually any food product. Our roots in fresh produce give us speed and agility — we operate 24/7 and can adapt to new requirements more quickly than many traditional distributors.
supply_body: We've developed supply chain integration capabilities that support customers with pick-and-pack and third-party logistics. Our unique proprietary software, built specially for Bungle and our customers, digitises order management, freight costing and container tracking — giving customers complete visibility.
domestic_heading: Where we started — and still deliver daily.
domestic_body: Bungle retains its original fresh produce operations, with nationwide coverage and daily trade into retail and central markets across Australia. We supply major Australian retailers and run an active BungleFresh Care programme.
